notes: Geographic compilations reproduce IAU feature origins and reveal non-obvious shared namesakes. Full completeness and November 2026 future status could not be independently established; searched catalog may omit additional laureates.

Cori (lunar crater) Cori (lunar crater)

Cori is a lunar impact crater that is located in the southern hemisphere on the far side of the Moon . It lies less than one crater diameter to the north of the crater Baldet . To the northeast is the crater Grissom .
